name: eventora
description: Root scripts for Eventora client and server

scripts.install:all: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run install:server" "npm run install:client"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run start:server" "npm run start:client"
scripts.dev:all: npm run setup && npm run dev
scripts.start:all: npm run setup && npm run start
